$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only), and only once the Actor is public. Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Task names are unique across the whole Apify account, so each carries efinancialcareers. Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor. inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema. options follow defaultRunOptions in store.json.

tasks.name: efinancialcareers-quant-jobs-london
tasks.title: Find quant jobs in London on eFinancialCareers
tasks.description: Get the newest quant jobs in London from efinancialcareers.com, first posted in the last 30 days: quant researchers, traders, developers and analysts, with the company, pay when shown, sectors, whether an agency posted it and the link.
tasks.seoDescription: The newest quant jobs in London from eFinancialCareers: researchers, traders and developers, with company, pay, sectors, agency flag and link.

tasks.name: efinancialcareers-jobs-last-24-hours

Jobs that were only moved back to the top of the site's list are left out. Schedule it daily for a fresh feed.
